# monochroYOU

monochroYOU is a monochrome theme in the Material You idiom. Its recorded description names subtle accents and consistent styling across panes and interface elements.

![monochroYOU screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guimar10/monochroYou/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "monochroYOU"
    author: "guimar10"
    repo:   "guimar10/monochroYou"
    slug:   "monochroyou"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/monochroyou"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/guimar10/monochroYou"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guimar10/monochroYou/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a monochrome Material You–inspired look to Obsidian for a clean, cohesive interface. Focus on content with subtle accents and consistent styling across panes and UI elements."
}
```
